name: Purple Group Limited
source: Audited annual report FY2026 (year ended 31 August 2026), Purple Group Limited, consolidated statement of profit or loss and financial position; figures converted from ZAR thousands to rand. Operating Expenses combine commissions and payaways, expenses before other income and depreciation and amortisation, net of other income. Fair value and impairment adjustment of 7,768 thousand sits outside the panel schema between EBIT and profit before tax. The statement presents no cost of sales line, so Cost of Sales and Gross Profit are left empty. Net Profit is the amount attributable to owners of the company (79,722 thousand); total profit for the period including non-controlling interests is 112,043 thousand.
